description: An error a process on a host's machine had, kept by that host by its fingerprint (its kind and type and where it was raised): how many times, when first and last, the code it was on, what was on screen and the user's last actions before it.

app.description: The process it was in: the host's, Baude's, Record's, the phone's app, or Emission's.

kind.description: What it was: an exception nothing caught (on the main thread; on another thread; in a main-loop callback, which carries on), a critical or warning GLib or GTK logged, an error answered on the wire, an agent that exited by itself with a code other than 0, a draft its host didn't save, a message not sent, a page Emission couldn't load, or the phone's app crashing.

fingerprint.description: What it's kept by: its kind, its type and the frame of Baude's own code it was raised in (its file and function), or for one without a stack what tells it apart (the op and code, a log's domain and its message with numbers taken out).

type.description: The exception's class, the log's domain and level, the op, the agent's program.

message.description: What it said, its first line (the last time).

file.description: The file it was raised in, under the checkout, relative to it.

stack.description: Its frames (file:line function), the innermost last, at most 20 (the last time).

first.description: When it first happened, in seconds since the epoch.

commit.description: The commit the process ran the last time (its first 12 characters).

wire.description: The wire's version it spoke the last time.

first_commit.description: The commit it ran the first time.

screen.description: The schema/ui entity on screen as it happened ("Telemetry.dialog"), the last time; null in a process with no screen.

part.description: The entity's part the user had just used, by its name there, if one was used just before.

wire_op.description: The wire op it happened answering (a wire error's, an exception in a host's op).

code.description: A wire error's code (Error's), an agent's exit code.

crumbs.description: The user's last actions before it (at most 8), the earliest first, the last time.
